hypothesis: Retinal disease class is unchanged by horizontal reflection, while frozen DINO local evidence may change. Compare symmetric prediction averaging, feature averaging, pooled regional bags, and a shared regional head that penalizes disagreement between aligned reflected views.
reflection: Mirror the decoded 448 JPEG before resizing to320/448; align the 3x3 reflected regions to original coordinates. Do not re-encode the mirror as JPEG.
additional_no_fit_control: Use each existing milestone5 head and its original statistics on both views, then average probabilities; each outer fold uses its own pre-existing head, never the full-development head.
normalization: All normalization fit on the current fitting patients only. The paired bank has an explicit two-view axis; fitting statistics pool that axis, tying normalization across views.
parameter_control: Mean and region-bag controls use exactly the original head parameter count. Shared mirror pooling uses the same projections and two regional queries, with at most two extra learned nonnegative disagreement penalties.
evaluation: Three seeds for every trainable arm and original patient3fold CV, each with separate inner stopping patients. All promising arms need newly fixed repeated-patient confirmation before external testing.
external_test_policy: Frozen label-independent feature extraction allowed across the manifest; training, stopping, comparisons and selection use development patients only. No external metrics or predictions loaded.
